industry_future_thesis.adaptation: The disclosed adaptation is geographic customer development and three compressor brands; no supplied component-level evidence measures price realization, unit cost, customer retention, or cash conversion from that adaptation.
industry_future_thesis.company_exposure: The company produces refrigerator/freezer and commercial compressors and serves global refrigerator enterprises through HUAYI, JIAXIPERA, and CUBIGEL brands, while newly consolidated automotive-parts and cleaning-robot activities sit outside the demonstrated compressor perimeter.
industry_future_thesis.most_likely_regime: The supplied company disclosures support a mixed demand-and-cost regime: established compressor markets and global customers coexist with raw-material pressure, inventory build, and unproven new activities; they do not establish a company-specific volume or pricing outlook.
industry_future_thesis.normal_economics: Reported adjusted attributable profit fell from CNY 203.18 million in FY2016 to CNY 60.29 million in FY2017 as the report cited higher major raw-material prices; the reports do not allocate that deterioration among refrigerator, commercial, and new-business components.
industry_future_thesis.permanent_loss: The adverse path is that inventory funding, negative FY2017 operating cash flow, higher short-term borrowing, restricted assets, and unallocated acquisition/project commitments persist while core component cash generation is not demonstrated.
industry_future_thesis.profit_pool_transmission: For the disclosed compressor operations, customer absorption and product mix must pass through raw-material costs, inventory funding, receivables collection, and production investment before they can become consolidated ordinary earnings or cash generation.

industry_future_thesis.strongest_rival: No named rival is disclosed; the relevant rival is an unquantified global refrigerator-compressor competitor set.
industry_future_thesis.valuation_treatment: Keep the consolidated reported earnings reference conditional, use financing pressure only as a stress route, and exclude noncore/acquisition value until component-level profitability, cash, and capital-return evidence is available.

situation_model.summary: The disclosed enterprise is a production-oriented refrigerator and commercial-compressor group with global-customer exposure, newly acquired/noncore activities, and a sharp FY2017 cash-and-financing pressure signal that cannot be allocated among components from the supplied reports.

strongest_rival: No named rival is disclosed; the relevant rival is an unquantified global refrigerator-compressor competitor set.
survival_case: FY2017 consolidated operating cash flow was negative while short-term borrowings rose to CNY 2.021 billion and cash, receivable-bill, financial-product, and fixed/intangible assets were restricted or pledged. This is a group financing-pressure fact, not evidence assigning survival capacity to a particular compressor or acquisition component.
underwriting_route: Use the reported consolidated ordinary-earnings interval only conditionally; keep component cash, growth-capital return, and noncore effects out of a base route until same-scope evidence resolves them.

underwriting_thesis.central_path: The reported consolidated ordinary-earnings range is usable only as a conditional reference. The disclosed compressor core and customer position may be represented within it, but the evidence cannot separate the core from commercial, acquisition, working-capital, and growth-capital effects; FY2017 cash and borrowing pressure therefore remains a live adverse path.
underwriting_thesis.monitoring: Monitor same-scope component volume/price/cost disclosure, customer absorption and collection, inventory turns, component cash and maintenance/growth capital, debt/restricted-liquidity allocation, and acquisition/project returns against the four copied reversal observations.
underwriting_thesis.normal_earnings_treatment: Use the FY2015–FY2017 reported adjusted attributable-profit interval as a conditional consolidated reference. Do not allocate it to refrigerator or commercial compressors, and do not estimate adjustments for raw-material, acquisition, or new-business effects without a same-scope bridge.
underwriting_thesis.owner_cash_treatment: Operating cash less all long-lived-asset spending is a current capital-allocation and financing-pressure observation. Maintenance capital, component cash conversion, and return on growth capital are unobserved, so normal owner cash is unresolved rather than set to a negative point estimate.
underwriting_thesis.permanent_loss_treatment: Treat sustained inventory funding, weak operating cash, short-term borrowing growth, restricted assets, and unallocated project/acquisition commitments as the base adverse survival path; treat individual component attribution and growth-capital returns as conditional or unresolved.
underwriting_thesis.strongest_rival: No named rival is disclosed; the relevant rival is an unquantified global refrigerator-compressor competitor set.
underwriting_thesis.value_route_treatment: The conditional consolidated-earnings route is the only primary model role. Working capital and financing belong only in a stress role, while noncore, commercial-component, and growth-return routes remain excluded or unresolved.

value_route.route_reasoning: The only primary model role is conditional because its required consolidated reported-earnings reference is observable but not component-normalized. Financing is a stress route, and noncore, commercial-component, and growth-return routes remain excluded or unresolved rather than being converted into primary inputs.
